title: pkg/machine: unknown volume option is printed to stdout instead of logged
body: When parsing podman machine volume options, extractMountOptions in `pkg/machine/vmconfigs/volumes.go` prints an unrecognized option straight to stdout via `fmt.Printf("Unknown option: %s\n", o)`. Since SplitVolume runs during machine volume setup (`pkg/machine/shim/volume.go`), a typo'd option pollutes command output instead of being surfaced as a proper warning. It should use logrus like the rest of the package — small fix, no control-flow change.
